description: Six-panel composite figure (four SEM images plus two OIM maps). Top row, spanned by a double-headed arrow labelled "HR+CR+1023 K": secondary-electron fractographs of failed tensile specimens (a) 28Mn0Ni, (b) 28Mn5Ni and (c) 15Mn5Ni, each with a printed 10 µm scale bar. (a) and (b) display rough, dimple-covered rupture surfaces; (c) is visibly different, showing flat facets, microcracks and a long horizontal crack opening. Bottom row, spanned by an arrow labelled "15Mn5Ni-HR+CR+1023 K": (d) a lower-magnification SEM image of a polished cross-section with a 200 µm scale bar and a crack entering near the top-right; (e) an OIM-IPF map of a cracked region (5 µm scale bar) with an IPF triangle inset labelled 001, 101, 111, showing fine equiaxed coloured grains; (f) the matching phase-contrast map (5 µm scale bar) whose legend marks B2 blue and FCC red, with blue/black B2 and unindexed regions decorating grain boundaries. The group argues that 28Mn0Ni and 28Mn5Ni fail by ductile dimple rupture, whereas 15Mn5Ni fails by fast, crack-initiation-controlled intergranular/quasi-cleavage fracture along γ/B2 interphase boundaries. No numeric data values are printed on any panel.

observations.observation: Panels (a)-(c) are SEM fractographs labelled 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni respectively, each carrying a printed 10 µm scale bar, and are spanned by a double-headed arrow reading 'HR+CR+1023 K'.
Panels (a) and (b) show dimple (cup-like) rupture morphology, whereas (c) shows flat faceted quasi-cleavage appearance with a long horizontal crack and numerous microcracks.
The bottom row is spanned by a double-headed arrow reading '15Mn5Ni-HR+CR+1023 K', indicating all three bottom panels refer to the same alloy and heat-treatment condition.
Panel (d) is a low-magnification SEM cross-section image with a printed 200 µm scale bar, showing a crack entering from the upper-right of the field of view.
Panel (e) is an OIM-IPF map (5 µm scale bar) with an inverse-pole-figure colour triangle inset labelled 001 (bottom-left), 101 (bottom-right) and 111 (top).
Panel (f) is a phase-contrast map (5 µm scale bar) whose legend assigns blue to B2 and red to FCC; blue B2 and black unindexed regions form elongated networks bordering grains.

The caption identifies (d) as an SEM image, (e) as an OIM-IPF map and (f) as a phase contrast map of the cross-section of a failed tensile specimen of 15Mn5Ni alloy in the same heat-treated condition.
The caption states the fractographs in (a)-(c) come from failed tensile specimens of 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni alloys in HR + CR + 1023 K condition.
The citing text states that 15Mn5Ni specimens heat treated at 973 K and 1073 K showed negligible ductility (<1%) while 28Mn0Ni and 28Mn5Ni showed remarkable tensile elongations.
The citing text attributes ductile failure to 28Mn0Ni and 28Mn5Ni (dimple morphology) and crack-initiation-controlled, fast-propagating fracture with many microcracks to 15Mn5Ni.

The citing text claims 15Mn5Ni exhibits much less recrystallization of the austenite matrix and a large volume fraction of secondary-phase precipitation along grain boundaries forming precipitate-rich zones.
The citing text states that (d) reveals intergranular cracks and that (e) and (f) indicate crack propagation along γ/B2 interphase boundaries.

subfigures.description: SE-SEM fractograph of 28Mn0Ni (HR+CR+1023 K) tensile specimen, 10 µm scale bar; rough surface covered with fine dimples, indicating ductile rupture.
SE-SEM fractograph of 28Mn5Ni (HR+CR+1023 K) tensile specimen, 10 µm scale bar; dimple/tearing-ridge morphology similar to (a).
SE-SEM fractograph of 15Mn5Ni (HR+CR+1023 K) tensile specimen, 10 µm scale bar; distinctly flatter faceted (quasi-cleavage) surface with microcracks and a prominent horizontal crack.

Lower-magnification SEM image of a cross-section of the failed 15Mn5Ni specimen, 200 µm scale bar; a crack runs in from the upper-right corner. Intergranular character is only faintly resolved at this scale.
OIM-IPF map of a cracked cross-sectional region, 5 µm scale bar, with IPF colour triangle inset labelled 001, 101, 111; fine equiaxed coloured grains with black unindexed areas.
Phase-contrast map of the same region as (e), 5 µm scale bar; legend shows B2 in blue and FCC in red, with blue B2 and black unindexed zones forming boundary-connected networks.

unreadable_items: panel (d): crack path detail is only faintly resolved at the supplied resolution, so the intergranular character asserted in the citing text cannot be confirmed from the pixels
panel (f): black (unindexed) regions are not identified in the legend, so their phase assignment (e.g. κ-carbide) is not readable
